gloss: to take one's eyes off; to look away; to stop watching

definitions.gloss: to take one's eyes off; to look away; to stop watching
definitions.explanation: to stop paying attention or watching something, especially when continuous attention is needed for safety

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}さない→離す：19372_hanasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't take your eyes off the children.

examples.japanese: ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}した→離す：19372_hanasu⟧⟦{隙|すき}→隙：10999_suki_gap⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べていた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: The moment I looked away, the cat was eating the fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{目|め}を{離|はな}す⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見守|みまも}っている→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It's dangerous to look away even for a moment, so you need to watch constantly.

notes:
Very commonly used in parenting, childcare, and safety contexts. Almost always appears in negative or conditional forms — warning against looking away or describing what happened when someone did look away.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}さない→離す：19372_hanasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: don't look away
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}した→離す：19372_hanasu⟧⟦{隙|すき}→隙：10999_suki_gap⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in the moment one looked away
- ⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧{目|め}を{離|はな}す: to look away for just a moment
- ⟦{目|め}が{離|はな}せない→目が離せない：06890_megahanasenai⟧: cannot take one's eyes off (also means "riveting")

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目|め}が{離|はな}せない→目が離せない：06890_megahanasenai⟧: can't take one's eyes off — can mean both "must keep watching" (safety) and "captivating" (entertainment)
- ⟦{見守|みまも}る→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧: to watch over — the positive action of keeping watch
- ⟦{油断|ゆだん}する→油断する：25389_yudansuru⟧: to let one's guard down — broader carelessness, not limited to visual attention

USAGE:
The related expression ⟦{目|め}が{離|はな}せない→目が離せない：06890_megahanasenai⟧ has a dual meaning: "must keep watching" (parenting/safety) and "can't stop watching" (something fascinating). The volitional form {目|め}を{離|はな}す specifically means the deliberate or momentary act of looking away.
